title: UPSConfig
description: Persisted UPS configuration at /cubeos/config/ups.json per spec/005 REQ-408.

active_driver.description: Driver to use; one of the 3 supported (per spec/005 REQ-403/404/405).

i2c_addr.description: I2C 7-bit address. Typical: PiSugar3=0x57 (87), X1202=0x36 (54), X728=0x36 (54).

critical_pct.description: SOC threshold below which a CRITICAL event is logged.
